test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The population of a village is 12,000. If it increases by 10% the first year and decreases by 5% the next year, what is the population after 2 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive Multiplier = 110% of 95%

Net Multiplier = 1.10 × 0.95 = 1.045

Population after 2 years = 12000 × 1.045

Population = 12540

**∴ Answer = 12540**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Population = 12,000

First year increase = 10%

Second year decrease = 5%

**Formula used:**

Final Population = P × (1 + R₁/100) × (1 − R₂/100)

 12,000 Start 
• 
 +10% 13,200 Year 1 
• 
 −5% 12,540 Year 2 Final Population = 12,540 

**Calculations:**

Population after 1st year = 12000 + (10/100) × 12000

⇒ 12000 + 1200 = 13200

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 13200 − (5/100) × 13200

⇒ 13200 − 660 = 12540

**∴ The correct answer is (2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Percentage Change

For two successive changes of x% and y%, the effective change is [x + y + (xy/100)]%. Here, 10 − 5 + [10 × (−5)/100] = 4.5%.

Successive Growth Formula

If a value P changes by R₁%, R₂%, R₃%... then Final Value = P(1 ± R₁/100)(1 ± R₂/100)(1 ± R₃/100)...

Depreciation

If a value decreases at a constant rate R, the value after n years is P(1 − R/100)ⁿ.
